title: Pocket Cellar | Your wine, in your pocket

previews.description: A welcome page with product logo. Background color matches the theme.
A screen for creating a new wine cellar.

A screen displaying the user's wine cellar. This view is mimicking the wine rack, user can see the wine bottles and their details at a glance. User can also add new wines to the cellar from this screen just by tapping the empty space.
A preview screen showing a wine's details, including name, vintage, and purchase information.
A screen displaying a list of wines in the cellar. User can sort and filter wines based on different criteria such as vintage, grape variety, and region.
A screen showing detailed information about a specific wine.
A screen for archived wines. User can restore archived wines back to the cellar or permanently delete them.
A screen for managing app settings, including language preferences, themes, and default currency. User can also manage wine details such as grape varieties and regions.
